post.description: Step 1: email + password. Answers the second steps on offer (TOTP first; email code fallback).
Step 2 with the authenticator app: `mfa=true` (needed for approvals, price edits, settings).
Fallback second step: a 6-digit code to the staff member's work address (valid 10 minutes).
Step 2 with the email code: signed in with `mfa=false` (no approvals until TOTP is used).
A new access token. The refresh token rotates; a reused old one ends all the user's sessions.
End this browser's session: the refresh token is revoked and its cookie cleared.

Recovery step 2: the emailed code + a new password (min 12 characters); every session ends.

against overwriting a newer change (409).

Manager/MD takes over (AI off) or hands the conversation back (AI on).

§14 / D21: reply to the buyer on the same channel and company number, signed with the
salesperson's name. Goes through the outbound gate (consent, opt-out, 24-hour rule); a price that is
not in an approved quote is refused (422 `unapproved_price`). WhatsApp after 24 h of buyer silence
answers 422 `window_closed`: send again with `reopen_template=true`. The AI stops replying.

§14: click-to-call through the company number. The salesperson's phone rings first, then the
buyer; logged on the deal. Refused (422 `opt_out`) when the buyer asked not to be called.

conversation the buyer started. Same effect as a STOP: suppression list, queued follow-ups cancelled,
